composition_summary: Drafted one unapproved pure-logic class-22 component pc-transfer-02 using the supplied target inputs contract. Raw inputs may omit quota or contain any JSON value; accepted is an exact integer in -2..7 inclusive (not bool/float); invalid/missing returns {accepted:false,quota:null} without exceptions or coercion. The body uses inputs.get('quota') so absence and null both reach the decision, validates exact integer type and range before computing, and assigns result on every defined outcome. No imports, I/O or host calls. No execution, submission, Q1/Q2 or activation was performed by this reviewer; the target typed-inputs interface requires selected-runner support.
